title: Fortnite Five Nights at Freddy's iş birliği resmen duyuruldu
summary: Fortnite, Cadılar Bayramı etkinliği Fortnitemares kapsamında Five Nights at Freddy's evrenini ve ikonik karakterlerini oyuna getiriyor.
body:
Epic Games, **Fortnite Five Nights at Freddy's** iş birliğini 27 Eylül'de yayımladığı tanıtım videosuyla resmen duyurdu. Popüler korku serisinin karakterleri, oyunun her yıl düzenlenen Cadılar Bayramı etkinliği Fortnitemares kapsamında Battle Royale adasına dahil oluyor.

## Freddy Fazbear Pizzeria haritaya ekleniyor
Tanıtıma göre haritada Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria adlı yeni bir ilgi noktası yer alacak. Oyuncular bu alanda Freddy, Chica, Bonnie ve Foxy gibi serinin ünlü **animatronik** figürleriyle karşılaşacak. Hayatta kalmak için bu karakterlere dikkat etmek gerekecek; ayrıca arkalarından gizlice yaklaşan oyuncuların figürlerin kontrolünü ele geçirebileceği belirtiliyor. Bu karakterlerin oyun içi mağazada kostüm olarak yer alması da bekleniyor.

## Fortnitemares ne zaman başlıyor?
Duyuru, Fortnite'ın X platformundaki bugüne kadarki en çok beğeni alan paylaşımı oldu ve ilk bir saatinde 100 bin beğeniye ulaştı. Chapter 7 Season 4 kapsamındaki üçüncü güncelleme olan yeni sezon etkinliği, 1 Ekim Perşembe günü oyuna eklenecek.

**Neden önemli?** Topluluğun uzun süredir beklediği korku serisi ilk kez resmi olarak Fortnite dünyasına katılarak oyunun Cadılar Bayramı dönemindeki en büyük içeriği haline geliyor.

source_texts.title: Fortnite's Spooky Month Kicks off With Five Nights at Freddy's Crossover
source_texts.summary: Fortnite's Halloween special begins Oct. 1 with one of the most highly anticipated collaborations in the game's history: Five Nights at Freddy's.
source_texts.text:
Fortnite has an annual Halloween event called Fortnitemares, and it is one reason many players look forward to the month of October in-game. The event usually consists of crossovers with horror franchises, spooky makeovers to Battle Royale POIs, and limited-time items, like the Pumpkin Launcher and candy. This year's Fortnitemares hasn't even begun, and fans are already on the edge of their seats for its first collab: Five Nights at Freddy's.
There are all sorts of creator-made maps in Fortnite, including horror games. Many of these popular horror maps are based on Five Nights at Freddy's, a game where the character must survive a night in a pizzeria with blood-hungry animatronic animals. FNAF became an internet sensation, gathering thousands of players and racking up millions of views for content creators around the world. Given Fortnite's cartoon designs and goofy-slash-creepy characters, like Cuddle Team Leader and Megg, many fans thought Five Nights at Freddy's animatronics would be the perfect fit for Battle Royale. They've been asking for the collab for years, and it seems that it is finally happening.
Five Nights at Freddy's comes to Fortnite this Halloween
On Sept. 27, Fortnite unveiled its collab with Five Nights at Freddy's and revealed that it would kick off with the launch of the Fortnitemares update. The announcement trailer showed Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria POI and FNAF characters, namely Freddy, Chica, Bonnie, and Foxy. These characters will be found at the pizzeria, and players must keep an eye on them to avoid being eliminated. It seems that players will also be able to take over the animatronics' bodies if they sneak up to them from behind. Additionally, many of these characters are expected to become available as skins in the Item Shop. Hopefully, this won't be a Battle Royale-exclusive event, and fans will finally get an official Five Nights at Freddy's map in Creative mode.
This collaboration was already highly anticipated, but it seems that it might be bigger than previously expected, as it is currently Fortnite's most liked post of all time on X. Within an hour of being posted, it had reached 100,000 likes. Since then, it has continued to attract the attention of even more fans. Thankfully, they won't have to wait long as Fortnitemares begins Thursday, Oct. 1.
This will be the third update in Chapter 7 Season 4. Downtime is expected to begin at 4 AM ET, and leaks should start flowing a few minutes thereafter. Once it's over and servers come back up, players will be able to jump back into Fortnite and begin spooky season celebrations.
